title: Create: Programmable Logic
description: Create: Programmable Logic is a professional-grade Forge addon that introduces 11 advanced redstone components.
body:
# Create: Programmable Logic
Unlock the true brainpower of your factory with Create: Programmable Logic.

This mod adds 11 powerful, industrial-themed logic modules designed to bring advanced automation to the Create mod. From high-speed signal processing to complex digital memory and kinetic integration, Create: Programmable Logic gives you the tools to build precise, automated systems that were previously impossible.

## 🚀 Key Features
The Programmable Controller: A state-of-the-art "Logic Brain" that evaluates custom boolean expressions (e.g., (A AND B) OR NOT C).
Kinetic Logic: Use the S (Speed) variable to trigger logic based on whether your machines are spinning or stationary.
Digital Logic Gates: High-fidelity AND, OR, NOT, and XOR gates with tactile indicator lights.
Precision Timing: Customizable Logic Timers and Pulse Generators for complex sequencing.
Digital Memory: Robust SR Latches, D Flip-Flops, and Memory Cells for storing persistent machine states.
Advanced Counting: A multi-mode Pulse Counter that can emit analog signal strength or match-based triggers.

Bring intelligence to your contraptions and refine your logic with Create: Programmable Logic.
